caption: The drawing features two main objects on a plain, light-colored background. At the top center, there is a red and white plaid baby garment with wide sleeves and a ruffled edge along the bottom and sleeves. The garment has a round neckline with a small opening at the front. Below this garment, towards the left side of the image, there is a small drawing of a baby lying on its stomach, facing forward. The baby is wearing a shirt made of the same red and white plaid pattern as the garment above, paired with light-colored shorts. The baby's skin is light, and its hair is a pale blond or light brown. The artist's signature, "Edith Joiner," is visible in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Baby Coat
